title: Private Law 119-1: To authorize the President to award the Medal of Honor to James Capers, Jr., for acts of valor as a…
summary: H.R. 3377, "To authorize the President to award the Medal of Honor to James Capers, Jr., for acts of valor as a member of the Marine Corps during the Vietnam War.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Private Law 119-1 on 2026-03-26, according to Congress.gov.
